name: Towa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Towa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sale ethical drugs in Japan. The company operates through two segments; Domestic and Overseas. It provides its products in the therapeutic areas of digestive system, nervous system, and allergic diseases, as well as vitamins, antibiotics, and oncology products, as well as provide formulations from tablets, capsules, injectable, patches, eye drops, and other products. The company also offers IT service related to healthcare; disease risk testing services; and sale of quasi drugs.
